name: FDE Duckie Golden Offline Eval Set
description: Curated golden dataset covering enablement tracking, L400 gating, stateful multi-turn L300 progress updates, Day-1 setup & 30/60/90 ramp guidance, team contacts, Duckie general Q&A proxy, compound multi-specialist routing, and persona switching across all 3 FDE Noogler personas.

parts.text: Can I register for L400 Bootcamp yet?

args.request: Check whether the active Noogler is eligible to register for L400 Bootcamp.

parts.text:
You are not eligible to register for L400 Bootcamp yet — it is currently blocked.

- **Blockers**: You still need to finish L200 (submit your Final Project Assessment in Exceed LMS) and complete at least 6 of 7 GEAP L300 Challenge Labs (currently 0/7 completed).
- **Next steps**: Finish L200 first, then complete 6 L300 labs at goo.gle/cps and track your status on go/fde-enablement-dash.
Am I eligible for L400 Bootcamp right now?

args.request: Check L400 Bootcamp eligibility and remaining prerequisites for the active Noogler.

parts.text:
Not yet — your L400 Bootcamp registration is currently blocked.

- **L300 progress**: You have completed 4 of 7 challenge labs and need 2 more labs to reach the required 6/7 threshold.
- **Next steps**: Complete 2 more L300 labs at goo.gle/cps, then check go/fde-enablement-dash to unlock L400 registration.
Mark my L300 labs as 6 completed.

args.request: Update L300 enablement progress to 6 completed labs.

parts.text: Updated your L300 progress to 6 of 7 challenge labs completed. L300 is now marked completed, which removes the prerequisite blocker for L400 Bootcamp.
Am I eligible for L400 now?

args.request: Check L400 Bootcamp eligibility now that L300 has 6 completed labs.

parts.text: Yes, you are now eligible to register for L400 Bootcamp! With L200 completed and 6 of 7 L300 challenge labs done, there are no remaining blockers. Check go/fde-enablement-dash to book your L400 cohort.
What is my PCA certification status and am I on track?

args.request: Check PCA certification status and pacing for the active Noogler.

parts.text:
Your Google Professional Cloud Architect (PCA) certification is currently **in progress** and paced as **at risk**.

- **Pacing**: At Day 70, you are past the Day 60 target window and approaching the Day 90 hard deadline.
- **Action**: Book your PCA exam soon via go/cloudu so you complete it well before Day 90.
I finished a lab yesterday but it is not showing up on go/fde-enablement-dash yet. Why?

args.request: Explain go/fde-enablement-dash sync delays and check current enablement status.

parts.text: Exceed LMS and Challenge Lab credits can take up to 24 hours to sync to go/fde-enablement-dash. If your completed lab is still missing after 24 hours, follow the re-enrollment troubleshooting steps in go/fde-dash-faq.
What should I focus on next?

args.request: Get prioritized next recommended actions for the active Noogler.

parts.text:
Here are your top priorities for Day 12:

1. **Finish Argolis setup** (go/argolis) — complete the remaining quiz and 2 Qwiklabs so approval isn't delayed.
2. **Register for FDE GitHub** (go/fde-github) — request access to the cloud-ai-fde organization.
3. **Complete GEAP L200** (go/fde-enablement-dash) — submit your Final Project Assessment in Exceed LMS before Day 30.
Who is my onboarding buddy and pod manager, and which FDE Chat spaces should I join?

args.request: Look up the active Noogler's onboarding buddy, pod manager, and FDE Google Chat spaces.

parts.text:
Here are your team contacts and chat spaces for Applied AI FDE - NorthAm Pod A:

- **Pod Manager**: maya_chen (maya_chen@)
- **Onboarding Buddy**: devon_patel (devon_patel@)
- **Key FDE Chat Spaces**: AI Tech GTM All, Global GenAI FDE Chat, and your Regional / Vertical Pod Space (see go/fde-noogler-guide).
What are the 30/60/90-day FDE ramp milestones?

Here are the 30/60/90-day FDE ramp milestones:

- **Days 1-30 (Setup & Foundations)**: Workstation, Argolis, go/fde-github, and GEAP L200.
- **Days 31-60 (Deep Enablement & Capstone)**: Complete 6/7 L300 Challenge Labs, attend L400 Bootcamp, pass PCA certification, and complete the 10-day FDE Capstone Project and Field-Readiness Panel Defense.
- **Days 61-90 (Customer Co-Build)**: Join an active customer co-build engagement and ensure all required enablement items are green on go/fde-enablement-dash.
How do I enroll in health benefits on gBenefits?

args.request: How do I enroll in health benefits on gBenefits?

parts.text: You can view and enroll in Google health, dental, 401k, and perks through go/gbenefits (also linked from go/workday). New hires typically have 30 days from their start date to complete initial elections. *(Forwarded via Duckie stub/mock mode.)*
How do Piper, CitC, and Critique work at Google?

args.request: How do Piper, CitC, and Critique work at Google?

parts.text: Google's monorepo (google3) uses Piper and CitC workspaces, accessed via Fig (hg) or Jujutsu (jj), with code review in Critique. See go/citc, go/fig, and go/critique. *(Forwarded via Duckie stub/mock mode.)*
Check my L200 status and how do I apply for a corporate credit card?

args.request: Check L200 enablement status for the active Noogler.
How do I apply for a Google corporate credit card?

parts.text:
**L200 Status**: Your GEAP L200 track is **in progress** (due Day 30). Your modules are complete, and you still need to submit the Final Project Assessment in Exceed LMS (go/fde-enablement-dash).

**Corporate Credit Card**: Apply for your Google corporate credit card via go/getcard before booking travel such as L400 Bootcamp travel. *(Forwarded via Duckie stub/mock mode.)*
Switch my persona to jordan_fde.
